name: AI Translator
description: TMGMT implementation of AI Module to allow use of many AI Providers like OpenAI, Ollama, etc.
project_description: The AI TMGMT (Translation Management) module is an AI translator plugin for the Translation Management Tools (TMGMT) project. It uses the AI module under the hood to allow you to use OpenAI, Ollama, and many more other providers (both paid and local/free). It contributes a single TMGMT translator plugin (id 'ai') that sends job-item text to whichever chat provider the AI module has configured, using either a basic per-translator prompt or, optionally, the AI Translate sub-module's per-language prompts. Text is chunked by token count, queued on the 'ai_translator_worker' queue, and processed via batch (UI) or cron (continuous), with rate-limit backoff and retry handling. Translations flow through TMGMT's normal review and acceptance workflow. Requires drupal/ai and drupal/tmgmt.
